rewrites.comment: The API is proxied through this origin rather than called cross-site. Auth cookies are SameSite=Lax, and Lax is what stands in for a CSRF token here — a Lax cookie is not sent on cross-site XHR, so calling the API on its own domain would break every authenticated request. Same-origin also means no CORS preflight at all. Replace the host below with the deployed API; keep the /api suffix on both sides.
SPA fallback. Vercel checks the filesystem before rewrites, so built assets, robots.txt and sitemap.xml still resolve.

headers.comment: Hashed filenames, so they can be cached forever.
